events.title: Elzypon Demo Is Out Now
events.summary: After a year and a half of working on everything the Elzypon demo is now live.Any small bugs we notice will be cleaned up as the week progresses. If you notice anything you can submit a ticket here and we will tend to it ASAP.The Kickstarter is also live and we've raised around 20% of our final goal already. You can find the Kickstarter link below as well.I hope you get something from it, Thanks again!https://linktr.ee/neolumism

events.title: Elzypon Update 2
events.summary: Hello,I hope everyone is well. Today we reveal a trailer showcasing nearly every aspect of Elzypon (Combat, Navigation, Some UI, Character Interactions etc.)You can check it out below or on instagram ( @Neolumism)Thanks so much for the support. We're currently at 7k wishlists, very much hoping to hit 10k by the time Next Fest starts!If you haven't seen already, we'll be running a kickstarter in tandem with the demo premiere during next fest. We'll be attempting to raise $20k to cover the remaind

events.title: Elzypon Update
events.summary: Hello,I just wanted to give a quick update regarding Elzypon.Firstly, we have a playable game loop. We're currently balancing combat, importing/ assigning assets, and optimizing where we can every day.Secondly, a playable demo is being prepared for the Steam Next Fest in October 2026 In conjunction with a Kickstarter that'll help with getting everything wrapped up by mid-2027.Below is a screenshot from an animation I recently finished that discusses the lore for the 3rd world, Netzach/ Venus.
